material_findings.finding: The utility bank is admitted through existing reader.bound, which checks in-root nonsymlink path, byte count and pre-load SHA256 but accepts a writable file. No readonly check or post-deserialization/analysis byte/hash recheck protects this scientific payload in the extension.
material_findings.consequence: The stated immutable exact bank custody is weaker than the required future admission: a writable bank is admitted, and mutation after the initial hash can escape detection. The prior summarizer rehashes each payload after analysis (summarize_B.py:240). The utility producer writes readonly banks (run_utility_H16.py:201-204), but that intended state is not enforced here.
material_findings.required_remedy: A separately reviewed successor should require the exact utility bank to be readonly before decode and recheck its size/hash after deserialization and analysis, before result publication. An enabling flag alone does not remedy this finding.

geometry_checks.complete_population: Source lines96-143 require exactly16 episodes of first_order_utility_live, all10 lexicographic pairs, exact item/left/right counts, both cost-kind tags and detached finite CPU [n_pair,4] F/U tensors. Flat cells preserve all160 cells and each per-pair16-episode series; no cell is selected by its value.
geometry_checks.row_and_member_join: Accessor _projection validates the original hash roles and increasing node-ID row order; _read_compact validates B IDs and labels. Source232-238 copies only the original S labels. The pair mask253 preserves increasing S order and interleaved target labels, matching native_sparse_port.py:163-177. Utility emission stacks columns in the fixed self.phis tuple order (utility_control.py:122-151). Counts alone are not used to invent signs.
geometry_checks.current_graph: Source239-275 decodes only public edge_index, reuses the qualified native to_undirected/remove_self_loops/add_self_loops recipe, then selects native[0]<native[1] to retain each nonloop undirected edge once. It restricts to the genuine pair rows and sets uniform W=K/(1+max degree), matching PROTOCOL and native_sparse_port.py. No public-path/two-hop source is imported or selected. Pair nodes, nonloop edges, cross-target edges and isolates must equal the admitted census.
geometry_checks.shared_scale: Source117-129 uses X_D=D-row_member_mean, s_F^2=0.001^2+||X_F||^2/(n_pair*4), identically for F/U, signed/unsigned and both centerings in a cell. Utility's own recomputed scale is separately labeled and compared with its recorded scale.
geometry_checks.centerings: Both member_only Y=X and row_column_tangent Y=X-column_mean(X)=P_n D P_M are retained. Target signs are applied afterward in energy_row:67, without node recentering. Offset norm, Pythagorean, row-center, column-mean and norm residuals are retained. target_weighted_signed_column_mean is the mean of J(JY)=Y; it is not an extra recentering of JY.
geometry_checks.quadratics_and_identity: energy_row:66-93 computes G0=sum_i<j w||Y_i-Y_j||^2 and Gt=sum_i<j w||t_iY_i-t_jY_j||^2 without gamma/2. It retains Gt-G0-4*sum_cross w<Y_i,Y_j>, which is the specified pure-gauge identity. The same signs, W and vertex order serve both comparisons.
geometry_checks.denominators_and_undefined_values: Node denominator is n_pair*4*s_F^2; edge denominator is omega*4*s_F^2 with omega=number_of_nonloop_edges*weight. Edge values are null at zero omega; orientation contrast (Gt-G0)/(Gt+G0) is null when both energies vanish. Raw zero energies and cells survive. Equal-cell summaries use all160 cells for defined energy fields and explicitly count null orientation contrasts. Coverage retains node/class counts, same/cross edge counts and masses, isolates and nonisolates; no unique-node interpretation of pair totals is asserted.
geometry_checks.interpretation: Output is descriptive geometry of utility-trajectory finite softplus-loss-response and first-order private-gradient cost proxies. It does not identify canonical-logit change or susceptibility, ordinary six-arm raw response, prediction quality, optimized-Q equivalence, causal gain, graph choice or a new gate. The member projection does not remove unknown member-varying susceptibility weights. Fragmented induced supports remain fragmented under target signs.

custody_and_scope_checks.disabled_and_root_gate: SOURCE_RELEASED is false. Future admission requires explicit execute flag, exact readonly root release SHA, source/MANIFEST/INPUTS hashes, frozen source-review refs, true approval for whole utility payload and joint-B label decode, and false flags for fitting, held labels/scoring, R-label analysis, Q/query-loss analysis, model/checkpoint/prediction access, tuning and gate changes.
custody_and_scope_checks.metadata_and_helper_custody: frozen validates readonly metadata/source, exact hashes/bytes, root confinement and nonsymlink ancestry. The reviewed source imports the pinned existing summarizer validators and pinned accessor only after authority. Their top-level source is stdlib-only; their full data loader and model routines are not called.
custody_and_scope_checks.whole_decodes_disclosed: One weights_only CPU torch.load deserializes the entire exact utility B diagnostic payload, including unused Q/query-loss/training scalars. The exact B compact decoder reads joint W/S/R labels; only copied S labels and F/U banks plus count/kind/scale metadata enter this calculation. Both whole decodes are disclosed in INPUTS/PLAN/output and require exact root approval.
custody_and_scope_checks.excluded_access: No code path here opens A/VALID/TEST label artifacts, model/checkpoint/prediction artifacts, or uses R labels in the analysis. Public NPZ features and masks are not decoded. Future metadata authentication hashes the public archive and the reused native-edge helper computes logical edge hashes; this review performed no raw payload hash or decode.
custody_and_scope_checks.specification_binding: INPUTS carries the exact SPEC SHA and is bound by source authority/packet manifest. Runtime reports that SHA rather than rereading SPEC. This review independently checked the local SPEC bytes.
custody_and_scope_checks.preparation_report_name: REPORT.md does not exist in the reviewed preparation. PLAN.txt is its manifest-bound explanatory document and was reviewed; no missing REPORT content was assumed.

runtime_and_output_assessment.compatibility: The source requires Linux host anogena-2-0, exact allocation repo, Python3.11 native_ncn_runtime interpreter, the existing repository PYTHONPATH, empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and Torch2.1.2+cu118 from the pinned repository installation. It uses the existing safe-load keyword, CPU tensors and one Torch intra/inter-op thread. The admitted census executed the same interpreter/PYTHONPATH and accessor native-edge recipe successfully. That is prior compatibility evidence, not execution of this extension.
runtime_and_output_assessment.framework_dependency: Accessor._native_edges imports existing Torch/PyG utilities and checks their loaded source hashes. No new graph framework is introduced; the dependency is real and is required at future runtime. No framework was imported during this review.
runtime_and_output_assessment.runtime_resources: This source's wall time/RSS is unmeasured and has no internal deadline/RSS cap. The prior census's8.5394 seconds is not a runtime or memory bill for the new diagnostic. Any future invocation remains root-owned and externally bounded.
runtime_and_output_assessment.output: One fresh in-phase directory and one readonly aggregate JSON are emitted after complete cell checks, with no raw node IDs, labels, or per-node fields. allow_nan=false rejects nonfinite serialization and stdout returns the result digest only after successful write/chmod. An interrupted/failed serialization may leave a partial fresh directory/file; only a completed receipt and exact returned digest should admit an observation.
runtime_and_output_assessment.provenance_note: Result retains source, INPUTS, spec, bank, context, census and native-helper provenance but omits the root release SHA. Keep the exact root release and invocation receipt with any future observation; the diagnostic artifact alone does not carry that approval binding.
runtime_and_output_assessment.cpu_evidence_limit: CPU tensors/map_location and empty visible devices support CPU intent. Unlike the prior summarizer, the extension has no final torch.cuda.is_initialized assertion. No numerical execution or CUDA state was tested in this review.

review_activity.scope: Local source/metadata text and authorized aggregate census only, within P.
